svg.data-cluster-scale: standalone or clustered from 2.4 Tb/s up to 134 Tb/s, interoperating with the rest of the S9700 series through an S9705-48D or S9725-64E fabric
svg.data-input-ac: 100 to 240 V, 12 A max per feed
svg.data-input-dc: -40 to -75 V, 40 A max per feed
svg.data-circuit-reserve: at least 1300 W reserved on each of two independent power circuits (HIG Installation Environment Requirements)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25GBASE SFP28 ZR/ER/LR/SR; 10GBASE SFP+ ER/LR/SR; 1GBASE SFP EX/LX/SX (datasheet compatible transceiver list)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the two 10G SFP+ management ports take the same 10GBASE SFP+ ER/LR/SR and 1GBASE SFP EX/LX/SX modules the datasheet lists for the service ports; it publishes no separate compatibility list for them
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400GE QSFP-DD DAC, AOC and AEC only - the datasheet lists these six as Compatible FABRIC Cable Types, not as optics, because they carry the chassis fabric to an S9705-48D or S9725-64E rather than user traffic
svg.data-gnss: internal GNSS receiver supporting GPS/QZSS L1 C/A, GLONASS L1OF, BeiDou B1, SBAS L1 C/A (WAAS, EGNOS, MSAS, GAGAN) and Galileo E1B/C; RF sensitivity -166 dBm, and the GNSS port supplies up to 5 V DC at 150 mA to an active antenna
svg.data-timing-cable: 50 ohm SMA coaxial with a 1/4-36UNS-2B connector for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coaxial with a 10-32UNF-2A connector for 1PPS and 10MHz, each limited to 3 m; shielded RJ45 for ToD, limited to 3 m
svg.data-timing: GNSS SMA input, 1PPS and 10MHz SMB input/output and a ToD input/output RJ45; SyncE and IEEE 1588v2 with the Default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1 and G.8275.2 profiles plus SMPTE ST 2059-2 (extra licence), T-GM, T-BC/OC and T-TC. NOS integration is required to activate any of it
svg.data-console: RJ45 and micro-USB serial console, both lettered IOIOI on the faceplate, 115200 8N1 no flow control; the micro-USB side needs a Silicon Labs CP210x driver
svg.data-service-port: 1x USB 3.0 Type-A, described by the guide as a maintenance port
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15, Subpart B, Class A; ICES-003, Class A; EN 55032, Class A; EN 55024; EN 55035; EN 62479; EN 50663; EN 300 386; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; BSMI; VCCI CISPR 32, Class A; MTCTE; KC KS C 9832, Class A; KS C 9835; Anatel

circle.data-description: HIG Fan FRU LED table - Off (no input power), Green (fan FRU function normal), Amber (fan FRU abnormal, service is required). Three rows, no blink states: this table is shorter than the S9510-28DC family's and is transcribed as it stands rather than filled out from a sibling

circle.data-states: off ok standby fail input-lost warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no input power to all power supplies), Green (output on and OK), Blinking Green (standby state / only +5VSB on, or firmware updating), Red (critical event causing shutdown - failure, over current, short circuit, over voltage, fan failure, over temperature), Blinking Red (input power cord unplugged or input lost with a second supply still powered), Blinking between Green and Red (warning event, supply continues to operate - high temp, high power, high current, slow fan)
